lyrics.original: セツナハナビ 瞬けば
lyrics.english: When a momentary firework sparks

lyrics.original: すぐに散る運命 just like you and I
lyrics.romanization: sugu ni chiru unmei just like you and i
lyrics.english: It's destined to fade soon, just like you and I

lyrics.original: ひと夏の愛 oh I, oh I, セツナハナビ stay
lyrics.romanization: hito natsu no ai oh i, oh i, setsuna hanabi stay
lyrics.english: A summer love oh I, oh I, A momentary firework, stay

lyrics.original: 茹だるような夏の暑さに
lyrics.romanization: udaru you na natsu no atsusa ni
lyrics.english: The scorching heat of the summer

lyrics.original: この愛し方はよく似ている
lyrics.romanization: kono aishikata wa yoku nite iru
lyrics.english: It's just like the way we love each other

lyrics.original: 破裂しそうな光を待って
lyrics.romanization: haretsu shisou na hikari o matte
lyrics.english: Waiting for a spark that might burst any moment

lyrics.original: 残された時間数えてる
lyrics.english: Counting the time we have left

lyrics.romanization: How many, how many, how many times left

lyrics.original: 最後の夜にふたり
lyrics.english: Together on the last night

lyrics.original: 見上げた咲いては落ちる花火
lyrics.english: We look up at the fireworks that bloom and wither

lyrics.original: きっと僕じゃだめなのに夜空に祈る
lyrics.romanization: kitto boku ja dame na no ni yozora ni inoru
lyrics.english: Even though I know I'm not meant to be, I still pray to the night sky

lyrics.romanization: Don’t let me, don’t let me go please

lyrics.original: 濡れた心を灯す火などない
lyrics.romanization: nureta kokoro o tomosu hi nado nai
lyrics.english: There is no spark that lights our wet hearts

lyrics.original: 拭えない後悔 over, over, over now
lyrics.romanization: nuguenai koukai over, over, over now
lyrics.english: A regret I can't erase, over, over, over now

lyrics.original: 「行かないで」, 今更
lyrics.english: "Please don't leave", It's too late now

lyrics.romanization: How many, how many, how many times left

lyrics.original: ピークもいつしか過ぎ

lyrics.original: 気づけばもう近づいてる ending
lyrics.english: By the time I realized, we're already close to the ending

lyrics.english: I find myself replaying a scene I'll never forget
